_data_provenance: PR-MC-PA-1 — minimum-viable scaffolding manifest. Required fields only; every optional reference-data section (zone_tier, vacation_zones, coastal_zones, named_beaches, airports, airport_distances_km, validation_bounds, departments) is intentionally absent. The typed accessors in pulpo.countries.CountryManifest default-safe to empty containers, so the pipeline runs end-to-end with this manifest but emits no PA-specific zone/beach/airport intelligence. Reference data lands in PR-MC-PA-2+.
